typeInfo.description: Its high ammo capacity and rapid-firing feature make it perfect for dealing with swarming enemies.

description:
To investigate the luxury cruise ship Utopia, Elegg changes into her swimsuit.
She is equipped with a special weapon called BFG to take on special enemies.
As expected, the front display of her swimsuit plays BOOM.

levels.name: Hello Ghost
levels.description:
■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects 1 random enemy.
<color=#00AEFF>Possession lasts for 6 sec.
Ability: Find and capture ghosts possessing the enemy.
Required hit count: 100 time(s) in total, cumulative across all allies.
Effect: Captures 1 ghost when the required hit count reaches 100%. A maximum of 13 ghost(s) can be captured.
<word_group=10085>Recurring interval</word_group>: 6 sec</color>
■ Affects all Water Code allies.
<color=#00AEFF>Effects vary according to the number of ghosts. <word_group=10028>Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it</word_group>:</color>
1 or more ghosts:
<color=#00AEFF>ATK ▲ 9.57% of the skill user's ATK continuously.</color>
4 or more ghosts:
<color=#00AEFF><word_group=10009>Elemental Advantage Attack Damage</word_group> ▲ 20.68% continuously.</color>

lines.text: I can make sure you can enjoy BOOM out on the open seas.
Nothing beats chillin' on a floatie in the pool.
Is there anywhere near the sea where I can install BOOM?

How's my swimsuit?
Isn't it BOOMtastic?

Mr. Commander, wanna have a BOOMing good time? 
Guess what's on display? My swimsuit! Hehe.

You want to know more about my equipment?
Sure, let me give you a rundown!

I'm bored...
Swimming is exhausting...

Take your time.
I'll just be here relaxing on my floatie.
Next time we head out to sea, let's bring Ms. Trony with us.

Installing BOOM at the outdoor pool? 
I already did that ages ago!
If a ghost appears, I'll take care of it with my handy BFG!

BOOM anytime, anywhere!
Even out at sea!

Upgrade complete! 
BFG is ready for action!
The suction power got even stronger!
Hehe, things just got even more electrifying.
Oh! Thank you!
This will let me enjoy BOOM a lot more!

Mr. Commander, you know me so well.
I've been needing this for a while.
I'm not afraid of ghosts or anything when I'm with you, Mr. Commander!

Wanna float around the pool with me? 
It feels really great.

I think it'd be fun to play BOOM with this pad.
Wanna give it a go?
Let's start hunting some ghosts!
All right, tell me where to go.
Let's go this instant!
BFG, locked and loaded!
Let's make this electrifying!
I won't get electrocuted because of the water, will I?
Ghosts or Raptures, bring it on!
Recharging battery!
Don't worry! It's perfectly safe!
This is fast charging? How slow...
Wiring installation complete!
Connection complete! BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Berserk mode, activate!
BFG! BFG!
Ghosts eliminated!
That's how it's done!
Eek!
Ugh.
Ow, that hurt...
Uh oh, my battery's completely drained...
BFG! It's huge, it's cool, and it's a gun!
